notes: P16-D mission queue smoke manifest. Three ordered missions: success A (P16-C-style smoke worker + commit), controlled failure B (worker exits non-zero), success C (uncommitted output). Demonstrates sequential ordering, stop-on-first-failure (C is skipped after B fails), --continue-on-failure (all three run, aggregate still fails), and the failed-aggregate invariant. Default mode is dry-run; --execute runs the real batch through platform_worktree_executor.
